caption_en:
If countries were animals. Not by vibes. By data. 🐾

🇳🇱 Netherlands = beaver: 26% of the country is below sea level, so it builds dams and dikes (PBL Netherlands Environmental Assessment Agency, 2010).
🇨🇭 Switzerland = ibex: the last Swiss ibex was shot in 1809; in 1906 Switzerland smuggled ibex kids back from Italy. About 17,000 live there today (Swissinfo, 2017).
🇯🇵 Japan = tortoise: 107,677 people aged 100 or more (Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare, Sept 2026).
🇦🇪 UAE = falcon: falcons get passports; more than 28,000 issued since 2002 (Environment Agency Abu Dhabi via Gulf News, 2018).
🇮🇱 Israel = hedgehog: small (about 22,000 km², roughly 0.015% of the world's land, our math: Israel CBS 22,072 km² ÷ Earth's land 148.9 million km²), spiky (Iron Dome intercepted about 90% of the rockets it engaged over populated areas in 2014, IDF) and still cuddly: 8th happiest country on Earth (World Happiness Report 2026).

Small, spiky, happy.

Which animal is your country? Tell me in the comments.

Photos (Wikimedia Commons): Giles Laurent (CC BY-SA 4.0); Bouke ten Cate (CC BY 4.0); Denkrahm (CC BY 4.0); Lisa James (CC BY 4.0); Denise Chan (CC BY-SA 2.0); Yuriy75 (CC BY-SA 3.0); Israel Defense Forces (CC BY 2.0); Dan Harrelson (CC BY 2.0). AI voice.
caption_he:
אם מדינות היו חיות. לא לפי תחושה, לפי נתונים.
הולנד בונה (26% מתחת לפני הים), שווייץ יעל (הוברחו בחזרה מאיטליה ב־1906), יפן צב (107,677 בני 100 ומעלה), איחוד האמירויות בז (לבזים יש דרכונים).
וישראל? קיפוד. קטנה, דוקרנית, ושמינית בעולם באושר.
איזו חיה המדינה שלכם?

lines.line: Five countries as animals. Not by vibes. By data.
Twenty six percent of the country is below sea level. So they build dams. Professionally.
In eighteen oh nine, the last Swiss ibex was shot. In nineteen oh six, Switzerland smuggled some back from Italy.
Today, about seventeen thousand. Very organised.
Over one hundred seven thousand people aged one hundred or more.
Literally. Falcons there get passports. Over twenty eight thousand of them.
Small: about point zero one five percent of the world's land.
Spiky: Iron Dome stopped about ninety percent of the rockets aimed at its cities.
And somehow, still cuddly. The eighth happiest country on Earth.
